'''Kevan Orr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Orr bought, sold, and built [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] and robotics at his shop in the [[Senate Commercial District]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kevan Orr appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a cybertech vendor on Coruscant.<ref name="TOR" />
